verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in the evidence is the Marketing API's account export endpoint, which generates or downloads a full account export (docs-16). Other documented API operations, such as creating a contact (docs-4), work on one item at a time. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk write endpoints (e.g., bulk contact add/update/delete), bulk edit of campaigns or tags, an agent-friendly way to run multi-item operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
